intro: Welcome to Tolpods. Let's take a quick tour: first the outside, and then the inside.
outside0: This is the entrance. A wide pathway leads into the pod, with premium storage on the right.
outside1: At the back, there is a vending machine on each side.
outside2: One for snacks, and one for cold drinks and snacks.
outside3: Between them is an interactive screen. Payment is by card, or tap to pay.
outside4: The left side of the pod carries a large T V screen for ads.
outside5: And so does the right side.
outside6: That is the outside. Now, let's step inside.
inside0: The ramp leads to a wide entrance.
inside1: The entrance end is open floor.
inside2: Above it, a T V hangs from a rail on the ceiling.
inside3: The massage chair. Sit upright, or recline all the way back to full zero-gravity. A leg extension adds ten inches.
inside4: At the entrance end, a floor-standing unit holds fifteen packets of pillows and blankets, released one at a time from the app.
inside5: A slim screen above shows your pod timer, and your boarding gate.
inside6: Next to the pillows, a smart minibar with thirty-six items, and cleaning supplies below.
inside7: Above it, a charging panel: four U S B C ports, two U S B A, a universal outlet, and a wireless pad.
inside8: By the back wall, three brass hooks and a shelf with a wireless charging puck, for your coat and bags.
inside9: A second minibar, with open weight-sensor shelves behind a sliding door with an app lock, and chilled drinks below.
inside10: Smart trash: four rotating cans with compactors, and a no-touch opening.
inside11: And premium storage: a full-height locker for a large suitcase.
outro: That is Tolpods. A private place to rest, recharge, and reclaim your layover, right in the middle of the airport.
